entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Nagpur Bench, Nagpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr U. A. Gosavi, Advocate for the appellant

Ms Kavita Bhondge, Agp for the State/respondent Nos. 2 and 3
 Mr Pavan Sirse, Adv. h/f.

Mr R. J. Shinde, Advocate for respondent No.1
 Coram : G.A. Sanap, J.
Date : March 13, 2024.
Heard learned Advocate for the appellant, learned holding Advocate for respondent No.1 and learned AGP for respondent No.1.
2. This is an application for condonation of 595 days delay caused in filing cross objection.
The reasons have been stated in the application.

3. In view of the reasons, the application is allowed subject to condition that respondent No.1 (in appeal) herein shall not be entitled to get any statutory benefits, including the interest payable under the Land Acquisition Act on the enhanced amount of compensation for the delayed period, in case the cross 2 24.cao.331.2024 objection is allowed.
4.
Delay of 595 days caused in filing cross objection stands condoned.
5. The cross objection be registered.
6. The civil application stands disposed of, accordingly.
